title: Natural History in Children up to 16 Years With Mild to Profound Hearing Loss Due to Mutations in GJB2 / OTOF Genes
official: Longitudinal Study of the Natural History of Two Autosomal Recessive Non Syndromic Deafness (DFNB1A and DFNB9) in Children up to 16 Years of Age
summary: The purpose of this study is to follow the natural history of non-syndromic hearing loss caused by mutations in two genes (GJB2 or OTOF) in children up to 16 years of age.
